newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - COCOA SEEN UNDRAMATIC, DUE DOWN.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - COCOA SEEN UNDRAMATIC, DUE DOWN.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Technical analysts did not expect a lacklustre cocoa market to produce a sharp change in direction.
Traders called it open around three stg lower.
"The selling pressure is diminishing," independent technical analyst Elli Gifford said.
"There's not a lot of action there," she said.
Brokers GNI described trading in cocoa as "mired in the summer lull."
"The (Bank of England) rate rise in the UK was tempered by the hint that no further moves were to come and therefore the impact on cocoa was minimal," GNI said.
New York cocoa futures ended unchanged to slightly higher on Thursday, in a market consolidation following three consecutive sessions of sharp losses, dealers said.
